# bft-progress-council-mcp

> Progress Council MCP — 5-voter majority-tally anti-loop guardrail halts agentic loops when no real progress is happening (earlier "Byzantine/BFT" consensus-strength phrasing retracted 2026-07-29; see https://councilof.ai/api/corrections). Stops tokens bleeding on infinite spins. By MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- start_session
- record_action
- council_vote
- get_session_summary
- estimate_tokens_saved
- list_voters

## Install
```
pip install bft-progress-council-mcp
```
